WITH county AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, "School Name", "Free Meal Count (K-12)", "Enrollment (K-12)",
         "Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS rate
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS ar FROM county
),
top_school AS (
  SELECT * FROM county ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t."School Name",
  s.Charter,
  s.GSserved,
  CASE
    WHEN sa.NumTstTakr IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
    WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
    ELSE 'Above Average'
  END AS SAT_Performance,
  t.rate - a.ar AS deviation_from_county_average
FROM top_school t
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = t.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = SUBSTR(t.CDSCode, 1, 7) || '0000000'
